sources.snippet: The base Gemma-4-26B-A4B architecture possesses immense latent power, but lacked the strict directive to execute agentic workflows reliably. Base models hesitate, hallucinate tool calls, and forget standard library imports. Xenon-26B-A4B resolves this through precise, surgical LoRA adaptation. sources.snippet: The "A" in 26B A4B stands for "active parameters" in contrast to the total number of parameters the model contains. By only activating a 4B subset of parameters during inference, the Mixture-of-Experts model runs much faster than its 26B total might suggest.
